name: Vietnamese American Voters Line Up for Republicans in California
summary: On November 3, 2026, long lines formed at California polling stations as Vietnamese American voters showed enthusiastic support for Republican candidates, captured in widely shared video footage. Online reactions celebrated the energy, tying it to the community's history fleeing communism and pushing for shifts on economic policy and government direction amid key races like the governor's contest.

hook: Amid historic pagodas and high-level talks, National Security Advisor Ajit Doval reinforced deep bonds between India and Vietnam through defence and security discussions.
name: India's Ajit Doval Strengthens Ties with Vietnam on Hanoi Visit
summary: During a two-day official visit to Hanoi, Doval met Vietnam's top officials, including Defence Minister General Phan Van Giang and Public Security Minister General Luong Tam Quang. They reviewed bilateral defence cooperation, explored deeper ties in cybersecurity, maritime security, and intelligence sharing, and discussed a potential agreement on protecting classified information. The visit, part of the upgraded India-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, also included a stop at Quan Su Pagoda to highlight shared Buddhist heritage and came ahead of the 55th anniversary of diplomatic relations in 2027. Some online observers noted its timing after Rahul Gandhi's recent trip to Vietnam.
